orders.selectAll: Select all orders waiting to be accepted
orders.searchPlaceholder: Name, area, last 4 digits or WD-number
orders.acceptedSome_one: {{count}} order accepted. {{skipped}} had already changed, so they were left as they are.

signIn.title: Office sign-in
signIn.body: Enter your mobile number. We will send a 6-digit code by SMS.
signIn.codeTitle: Enter the code and your password
signIn.passwordHint: Signing in for the first time? Leave this empty and you will create a password next.
signIn.newPasswordBody: You will need it with an SMS code each time you sign in to the office portal.
signIn.newPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.

customers.searchPlaceholder: Name, area, PIN code or last 4 digits
customers.empty: No customer matches "{{q}}". Check the spelling or try the last 4 digits of their phone.
customers.none: No customers yet. They appear here when they sign up in the app or when you add one.
customers.name: Name
customers.addressError: Fill in the house, landmark and a 6-digit PIN code, or leave all three empty.
customers.phoneError: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.

customer.switchedOff: Customer switched off and signed out of the app.

cards.privacyNote: They accept it the first time they open the app.

customer.noAddresses: No address yet. Add one so orders can be delivered.

team.staffIntro: People who deliver. They sign in on their phone with an SMS code once, then a 4-digit PIN.
team.addStaffHelp: They download the WtrDrop app and tap "Delivery staff sign-in" with this number.
team.addAdminHelp: They sign in at this portal with this number and create their own password.

done.reset: {{name}}'s PIN was reset. They sign in with an SMS code next time.

off.title: Switch off {{name}}?
off.body: {{name}} is signed out at once and cannot sign in until you switch them on again. Their history is kept.

on.title: Switch on {{name}}?
on.body: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

reset.title: Reset {{name}}'s PIN?
reset.body: Use this if they forgot the PIN or lost the phone. They are signed out and must sign in with an SMS code and choose a new PIN.

settings.areasHelp: Customers can only save an address whose PIN code is in an active area.
settings.noAreas: No delivery areas yet. Customers cannot sign up until you add one.
settings.needPin: Add at least one PIN code.
settings.teamHelp: Only the owner can add or switch off office accounts.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other browsers were signed out.
settings.windowsHelp: Customers choose one of these times. The number of cans is how many your vans can carry in that time.
settings.closedDaysHelp: Holidays or days off. Customers cannot book these; orders already booked stay, so call those customers.
settings.chargeHint: Leave both blank to use the business setting. 0 means free delivery in this area.
settings.badCharge: Enter an amount like 20, and a whole number of cans.

errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.OTP_INVALID_one: The code is wrong or has expired. {{count}} try left.
errors.OTP_INVALID_other: The code is wrong or has expired. {{count}} tries left.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong tries. Please ask for a new code.
errors.OTP_RESEND_TOO_SOON: Please wait {{seconds}} seconds before asking for a new code.
errors.OTP_LIMIT: Too many codes for this number. Please try again later.
errors.OTP_SEND_FAILED: The SMS could not be sent. Please try again in a minute.
errors.ADMIN_SIGN_IN_FAILED_one: The code or password is wrong. {{count}} try left.
errors.ADMIN_SIGN_IN_FAILED_other: The code or password is wrong. {{count}} tries left.
errors.SETUP_EXPIRED: This step has expired. Please start again.
errors.PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET: A password is already set. Please sign in with it.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are missing or incorrect.
errors.CUSTOMER_EXISTS: A customer with this number already exists.
errors.ALREADY_IN_TEAM: This number is already in the list. Switch it on instead.
errors.OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA: This PIN code is not in any active delivery area. Add it under Settings first.
errors.AREA_NAME_TAKEN: An area with this name already exists.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You cannot switch off your own account.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found. It may belong to another supplier or have been removed.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a minute.
errors.WINDOW_FULL: That delivery time is full. Choose another time.
errors.DAY_CLOSED: Deliveries are closed then. Choose another day.
errors.TOO_LATE_FOR_WINDOW: It is too late to book that delivery time. Choose a later one.
errors.WINDOW_NOT_AVAILABLE: That delivery time is not available.
errors.PRICE_CHANGED: The price changed. Check the new total and save again.
errors.QTY_ABOVE_MAX: That is more cans than allowed in one order ({{max}}).
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This order has already changed. Reload the page to see it.
errors.TOO_LATE_TO_CANCEL: This order is already on its way and cannot be cancelled.
errors.DATE_IN_PAST: Choose today or a later date.
errors.WINDOW_NAME_TAKEN: A delivery time with this name already exists.
errors.WINDOW_TIMES: The end time must be after the start time.
errors.SETUP_INCOMPLETE: Ordering is not set up yet: add a price and delivery times under Settings.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This customer is switched off. Switch them on first.
errors.ROUTE_ALREADY_STARTED: This route has started, so its stops cannot be changed now.
errors.ROUTE_NOT_ENDED: The delivery person has not ended this day yet.
errors.STOPS_CHANGED: The stops changed. The page has been reloaded; try again.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_EMPTIES: There are not that many empty cans at the depot.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_DAMAGED: There are not that many damaged cans.
errors.NOTHING_TO_REFUND: There is no deposit to give back: the customer still has every can the deposit covers.
errors.NOTHING_CHANGED: Nothing was changed. Type the correct numbers first.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The payment date cannot be after today.
errors.PAYMENT_REVERSED: This payment was already marked not received.
errors.REQUEST_REUSED: This was already saved for another customer. Close the window and start again.
errors.BAD_RANGE: Choose a start date before the end date, at most a year apart.
errors.REMINDED_RECENTLY: A reminder was already sent in the last day. Try again tomorrow.
errors.NOTHING_DUE: This customer owes nothing, so there is nothing to remind.
errors.ALREADY_RESOLVED: Someone already resolved this complaint. The list is now up to date.

newOrder.title: New order
newOrder.noMatch: No customer found. Add them on the Customers page first.
newOrder.noAddress: This customer has no delivery address yet. Add one on their page first.

order.depositNote: The can deposit is an estimate. The driver records the real number of cans at delivery (Phase 5).

done.REJECTED: Order {{no}} rejected. Its cans are free again.
done.CANCELLED: Order {{no}} cancelled. Its cans are free again.

order.reasonHelp: The customer will see this reason, so keep it short and polite.
order.reasonNeeded: Write a short reason (at least 3 letters).

price.label: Price per can
price.title: Price for this customer
price.help: Leave it at the standard price ({{standard}}) unless you agreed a different price. It applies to new orders from today.
price.saved: Price saved. New orders use it from today.
price.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change prices.
price.standardHelp: Orders already placed keep the price they were placed at. Customers with their own price are not changed.
price.badDate: Choose today or a later date.

windows.none: No delivery times yet. Customers cannot order until you add one.
windows.badTimes: The end time must be after the start time.
windows.cansHint: Set 0 to stop new bookings without removing the time.

closed.help: Customers will not be able to book it. Orders already booked are not cancelled.
closed.savedWithOrders_one: {{when}} closed. {{count}} order is already booked then; call that customer.
closed.savedWithOrders_other: {{when}} closed. {{count}} orders are already booked then; call those customers.

deliveries.noStaff: There is no active delivery person yet. Add one on the page:
deliveries.noneWaiting: No accepted orders are waiting for this day.
deliveries.assignLabel: Give selected orders to a delivery person
deliveries.assignedSome_one: {{count}} order given to {{name}}. {{skipped}} had already changed, so they were left as they are.
deliveries.assignedSome_other: {{count}} orders given to {{name}}. {{skipped}} had already changed, so they were left as they are.
deliveries.noSlot: No delivery time on this day has room for these cans. Try another day.
deliveries.rescheduled: {{no}} moved to {{when}}. It now waits for a delivery person.
deliveries.noRoutes: No orders have been given to anyone for this day yet.
deliveries.removed: {{no}} taken off {{name}}'s route. It waits for a delivery person again.
deliveries.writeOffHint: Closing the day writes the missing or extra cans off the van, so the stock count stays right.
deliveries.moveHint: Every stop on this route moves to the person you choose, in the same order.

stock.routesOpen_one: {{count}} route is still out or not checked, so van counts may change. See
stock.routesOpen_other: {{count}} routes are still out or not checked, so van counts may change. See

help.filled: Empty cans at the depot that came back full from the plant.
help.count: Type what you counted. The difference from the system is recorded with your note.
help.bought: New cans added to the business.
help.discarded: Damaged cans that are thrown away or sold for scrap.

ledger.title: Cans, deposit and money
ledger.note: Entries are never changed. A mistake is fixed by a new entry that reverses it.

money.subtitle: Dues, payments and UPI to check
money.badAmount: Type an amount in rupees, like 380.
money.upiCheckHint: UPI payments are marked “Check in bank” until someone sees them in the bank account.
money.refundHelp_one: Deposit held {{deposit}} for {{cover}} cans. The customer has {{held}} cans now, so {{count}} can's deposit can be given back.
money.refundHelp_other: Deposit held {{deposit}} for {{cover}} cans. The customer has {{held}} cans now, so {{count}} cans' deposit can be given back.
money.refundAdjusted_one: {{amount}} for {{count}} can taken off the dues.
money.refundAdjusted_other: {{amount}} for {{count}} cans taken off the dues.
money.correctHelp: Type what is true now. Each difference is saved as a correction with your reason; past entries stay as they are.
money.balanceHint: Use a minus sign if the customer has paid in advance, like -200.
money.badNumbers: Use whole numbers for cans and rupees for money.
money.ownerSetsLimit: Only the owner can change this.
money.limitHelp: How much this customer may owe. Above it, delivery staff and the office see a warning; deliveries are never blocked.
money.notReceivedHelp: {{amount}} from {{name}} goes back on their account. The payment stays in the list, marked.
money.noDues: No customer owes anything. All paid.
money.upiHelp: UPI payments not yet seen in the bank account, oldest last. Press Received after checking, or Not received if it never came.
money.upiNone: Every UPI payment has been checked.

statement.title: Monthly statement
statement.cansLine: Cans delivered {{delivered}}, returned {{returned}}, with the customer at month end {{closing}}.
statement.noEntries: Nothing was charged or paid this month.
statement.footer: Generated by WtrDrop from the account entries. Questions? Call the office.

opening.title: Opening balances
opening.help: For customers you served before WtrDrop: the cans they have, the deposit they paid and what they owe. Each customer can get an opening balance only once, before any other entry.
opening.empty: There are no customer lines under the first line.
opening.summary: {{fresh}} new customers, {{existing}} existing customers, {{errors}} lines that will be skipped.

codes.NAME_NEEDED: Name needed for a new customer
codes.NOT_A_CUSTOMER_HERE: This number is office or delivery staff

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.subtitle: Problems customers told us about
complaints.whatDoneHint: The customer sees this in the app, so write it for them.

business.title: Business details
business.name: Business name
business.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change these.

bad.name: Type the business name (at least 2 letters).
bad.gstin: That GSTIN is not valid. Check the 15 characters.

business.rulesHelp: These apply to every new order. Orders already placed keep their prices.

hints.deposit: Paid once for each can a customer keeps. Like 150.
hints.charge: Added to each order. 0 for free delivery. Areas can have their own.
hints.cutoff: Orders after this time go to the next open day.
hints.undoMinutes: 0 to 60. After this, only the office can correct a delivery.
hints.supportPhone: 10-digit mobile number. Customers call or WhatsApp it from Help. Leave empty to hide.
hints.auto: If off, someone in the office accepts each order.

reports.ageing: How long dues are owed: up to 7 days {{a}}, 8 to 30 days {{b}}, 31 to 60 days {{c}}, over 60 days {{d}}.
